name: Tokyo Odi et Amo: Mejiro Kimichika
original_name: 東京オディエットアモ　目白公親編
source:
The heroine, Juli Tengenji, was originally a daughter of an old family, but she fell into poverty for some reason and now lives in an apartment with her younger brother.

One Sunday she decides to take on a suspicious extra job, blinded by the high rewards. The part-time job venue was a party held in a privately owned mansion, but it was a "masquerade" held by Romeo Daisawa, a clan sergeant who was a former opponent. There, Juli is reunited with her childhood friend, Kimichika Mejiro.

The second season is based on "Hamlet," a neo-gothic love simulation game set in Tokyo that takes place over the course of just five days.

What will be the outcome for the two?

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6748]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
女主角朱莉·天元寺原本是一个古老家庭的女儿，但因为某种原因陷入贫困，现在和弟弟住在公寓里。

一个周日，她被高额报酬蒙蔽了双眼，决定承担一份可疑的额外工作。打工的地点是在私人宅邸举办的派对，但却是曾经的对手、藩士大泽罗密欧举办的“化装舞会”。在那里，朱莉与她儿时的朋友目白公亲重聚。

第二季改编自《哈姆雷特》，这是一款以东京为背景的新哥特式爱情模拟游戏，故事发生在短短五天内。

两人的结局又会如何呢？

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6748]NovelGame[/url]]
